market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI April 2026 high so far appears to be ~$98-99 (Apr 27-28). Only 2 trading days remain. To hit $110, WTI needs ~12% rally in 2 days — would need extraordinary geopolitical shock. Very low probability ~1-3%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sudden Middle East escalation is only path; probability slim with only days left in month.
